filings.description: SUMMARY:  On March 15, 2018, Palle Jensen, Executive Vice President of and Martin Mattes, a partner in Nossaman LLP, attorneys for, San Jose Water Company (SJWC), met with Cmmrs. Guzman Aceves, representatives of the Office of Ratepayer Advocates (ORA), representatives of the other three Applicant companies: Golden State Water Company, California-American Water Company and California Water Service Company, as well as members of the general public. SJWC representatives discussed the Proposed Decision (PD) of ALJ Bemesderfer. Mr. Mattes noted that ORA’s contention that California’s regulatory mechanisms substantially reduce the cost of equity for the Applicant utilities was inconsistent with the ORA expert’s testimony that investors only care about non-diversifiable risks. Mr. Mattes emphasized that setting low returns on equity would create disincentives for the water utilities to invest in acquiring failing or economically challenged water systems. Mr. Jensen noted that the PD accepted the ORA witness’s calculations of SJWC’s cost of debt and capital structure despite serious errors in the ORA forecasts. Written material (attached to the notice) was used.
